notes.subject: למנצח
notes.rationale: Superscription formula 'to the choirmaster', not part of the verse body.

notes.subject: אל תשחת
notes.rationale: Al-Tashet: likely the opening words of a known song ('destroy not'), kept as a title rather than translated into the sentence.

notes.subject: מכתם
notes.rationale: Mikhtam: 'engraved poem' or 'gold poem' — meaning uncertain, kept as Hebrew term.

translation: Ɲɛmɔgɔ ma; Al-Tashet (i kana a tiimɛ); Dawuda (Dawid) ta salimɔ; mikhtam.
